description: Dave McKeegan's YouTube channel focuses on debunking conspiracy theories, primarily flat Earth claims and moon landing denialism, using evidence-based explanations and his expertise as a photographer. His videos calmly analyze specific claims about space travel, flight paths, and visual evidence (like Apollo photos) to demonstrate why the scientific consensus is correct, often without demeaning those who believe the conspiracies. He also produces content on photography techniques and gear, which informs his analytical approach to visual conspiracy claims.
